package main

import "fmt"

var calls int

func f() int {
	calls++
	return calls
}

var pkgClosure = func() int { return 100 }

func main() {
	{
		f := func() int { return -1 }
		fmt.Println(f())
	}
	fmt.Println(f())
	if true {
		f := func() int { return -2 }
		fmt.Println(f())
	}
	fmt.Println(f(), pkgClosure())
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		f := func() int { return -3 - i }
		fmt.Println(f())
	}
	fmt.Println(f())
}
